title: Our Little Book of Memories ❤️
subtitle: A few moments from our journey together…

finalHeartfeltMessage.title: To My Forever Favorite Person ❤️
paragraphs: Every single moment spent with you has been a blessing. From late night talks to spontaneous adventures, you make every day feel like magic.
Thank you for being my strength, my joy, and my best friend. Looking forward to filling a hundred more scrapbooks with you!

photo.caption: The first smile that changed everything ✨

leftPage.note: Remember when we first talked for hours without realizing how fast time was flying?

photo.caption: Unplanned moments turn into forever memories.

rightPage.note: That awkward first photo together that turned into my absolute favorite.

photo.caption: Long rides, cool wind, and endless laughter 🏍️💨

leftPage.note: No fixed direction, just holding on tight and riding towards the sunset.

photo.caption: Sunset hues and ocean waves with you 🌊🌅

rightPage.note: The sea was beautiful, but I couldn't stop looking at you.

photo.caption: Quiet moments, warm tea, and sweet silence ❤️

leftPage.note: We don't even need words when we're together. Just existing in the same room is happiness.

photo.caption: Silently matching smiles and endless inside jokes 😂

rightPage.note: Nobody else gets our weird jokes, and that's our favorite secret.

photo.caption: Celebrating us, one milestone at a time 🥂🎉

leftPage.note: Looking back, every challenge only brought us closer together.

photo.caption: “In all the world, there is no heart for me like yours.”

rightPage.note: Maya Angelou had it right. Your heart is my home.

photo.caption: Our favorite picture of us taking on the world 🌍❤️

leftPage.note: This isn't the end of our story. It's just another beautiful page. ❤️

rightPage.calloutTitle: This isn't the end of our story.
rightPage.quote: The best is yet to come, hand in hand, step by step.
